translations.ig: Kama nke ahụ, pịnye arịrịọ gị

translations.key: Record up to 30 seconds. Confirm the words, then start learning.
translations.yo: Gba ohùn sílẹ̀ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá tó tó 30. Jẹ́rìí sí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ náà, lẹ́yìn náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́.
translations.ha: Yi rikodi na tsawon da bai wuce daƙiƙa 30 ba. Tabbatar da kalmomin, sannan ka fara koyo.
translations.ig: Dekọọ ruo sekọnd 30. Kwenye okwu ndị ahụ, wee malite ịmụ ihe.

translations.key: Keep your learning request under 600 characters.
translations.yo: Má ṣe jẹ́ kí ìbéèrè ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ ju àmì 600 lọ.
translations.ha: Kada buƙatar koyonka ta wuce haruffa 600.
translations.ig: Mee ka arịrịọ mmụta gị ghara ịkarị mkpụrụedemede 600.

translations.key: This saved request contains a different objective.
translations.yo: Ìbéèrè tí o ti fipamọ́ yìí ní ète mìíràn nínú.
translations.ha: Wannan buƙatar da aka adana tana ɗauke da wata manufa dabam.
translations.ig: Arịrịọ a echekwara nwere ebumnuche dị iche.
